source_name: World Bank Corporate Procurement — administrative/RFx business opportunities
why_relevant: Confirmed on-topic hit: RFx 0002007835 'Electronic Payments in North Macedonia' — a WBG/National Bank of North Macedonia assessment of the electronic payments acceptance ecosystem (issued Apr 2024). Shows the Bank buying MK payments-market analysis directly, naming the counterpart institution and scope.

source_name: World Bank ECA brief — Advancing Modernization and Integration of Payment Systems in the Western Balkans
why_relevant: Programme-level page for the regional payment-modernization workstream that MK participates in; identifies the reform agenda that will generate future donor-funded payment-infrastructure procurement, plus named counterpart institutions.

source_name: STEP — Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement (World Bank)
why_relevant: The upstream system of record behind all WB procurement plans and contract-award data; understanding its fields and publication lag is necessary to interpret and time the Finances One dataset.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal — external actions / PROSPECT (IPA)
why_relevant: Single entry point for EC-managed procurement and calls, including IPA III external actions with the MK country code (e.g. EuropeAid/186948/DD/ACT/MK). Captures directly-managed EU contracts for MK that never touch the national e-Nabavki portal.

source_name: EU Delegation to North Macedonia (EEAS) — local calls for tender
why_relevant: The Delegation publishes its own local procurement notices (supply/service framework contracts, expert rosters for IT supply contract evaluation) that are too small or too local for TED but reveal EU-funded IT/finance work and the firms bidding for it in MK.

source_name: CFCD — Sector for Central Financing and Contracting, Ministry of Finance (Сектор за централно финансирање и склучување договори)
why_relevant: The contracting authority for indirectly-managed IPA funds in MK: it alone runs tender procedures, signs contracts and pays contractors for EU-financed projects. Its notices and contract lists are the MK-side mirror of IPA procurement, in Macedonian, and cover PFM/IT modernisation packages relevant to financial infrastructure.

source_name: Ministry of European Affairs / Secretariat for European Affairs — IFI and IPA funds pages (ЕБОР, Светска банка, друга странска помош)
why_relevant: MK government's own donor/IFI coordination pages map which institution finances what, with dedicated pages for EBRD (ЕБОР), the World Bank, and 'other foreign assistance' — an actor map and pointer layer into programme documents and the beneficiary institutions that will procure.

source_name: e-Nabavki (ЕСЈН) — donor/IFI notices channel within the national e-procurement system
source_subtype: national e-procurement portal with IFI notice feed
why_relevant: Although e-Nabavki is the national portal (outside this cell's core), it carries an explicit function of publishing/raising visibility of notices from the World Bank, EBRD, EU Funds and other financial institutions, and its 'Склучени/Реализирани договори' grids expose awarded contracts. It is the bridge where donor-funded MK procurement becomes locally visible in Macedonian.

source_name: WBIF — Western Balkans Investment Framework, Procurements / Tenders & Opportunities
why_relevant: WBIF blends EU IPA grants with EIB/EBRD/CEB/KfW lending for Western Balkans projects including MK; its procurement page aggregates the technical-assistance and works tenders arising from that blended financing, which is exactly the cross-border channel that bypasses the national portal.

source_name: EIB — North Macedonia projects register and press releases
why_relevant: EIB Global finances MK financial-sector intermediation (e.g. EUR 100m green credit line with the Development Bank of North Macedonia, plus a EUR 1m TA grant, and EFSE participation). Project sheets and press releases name the intermediary banks and advisory programmes — the counterparties and the TA consultants who will shape downstream financial-infrastructure demand.

source_name: Development Bank of North Macedonia (Развојна банка на Северна Македонија) — on-lending programmes for IFI credit lines
why_relevant: MBDP/DBNM is the named national intermediary for EIB and other IFI credit lines (EIB project 20130166 'MBDP loan for SME & other priorities IV'; the EUR 100m green facility). Its programme pages and procurement notices reveal which IFI money lands where and which advisory/IT suppliers it engages.

source_name: Commercial-bank IFI credit-line pages (e.g. Sparkasse Bank Skopje — Посебни програми за финансирање)
why_relevant: MK commercial banks publish, in Macedonian, which IFI facilities they have signed (e.g. the EBRD Green Finance Facility at Sparkasse). This reveals donor-money flow into the banking sector and the partner network around it — a reveals-indirectly source that no procurement index carries.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (МСЕ) news — EBRD-funded market-financing project
why_relevant: Concrete, dated example of a donor-funded MK financial-infrastructure assignment where the implementing consultants are named (PwC North Macedonia and PwC Croatia) — exactly the competitor-identification signal this cell exists to catch, and it appeared in the local press/issuer channel rather than in a tender index.

source_name: DevelopmentAid — tender and award aggregator (850+ donor sources)
why_relevant: Aggregates EBRD, EC, WB, UN and other IFI notices with a North Macedonia location filter and sector tags including 'Financial Services' and 'Macro-Economy & Public Finance'. Useful as a cross-check/backfill layer and for catching notices whose primary channel is login-gated (e.g. ECEPP).

source_name: dgMarket — international donor tender portal
why_relevant: Long-running aggregator of World Bank, EU, UN and national donor solicitations with per-buyer indexes; a secondary net for MK donor-funded notices and a historical archive when primary portals rotate URLs.

source_name: OpenTender / Open Contracting Data Registry — TED + national portal harmonised dataset (incl. MK)
why_relevant: Collects, transforms and republishes contracting data for 35 jurisdictions including North Macedonia, merging TED with national portal data into a harmonised, analysable form — the cheapest route to historical vendor-share analysis across both the EU and national channels.

source_name: UNDP / UNOPS North Macedonia procurement notices
why_relevant: UN agencies act as implementing/procurement agents for donor-funded MK programmes including digital transformation and fund management; their notices name suppliers for IT and financial-services work that never reaches TED or e-Nabavki. UNDP also runs its own MK country-office procurement pages.

source_name: UN Development Business (UNDB)
why_relevant: World Bank procurement plans for MK explicitly state that contracts using the international market approach are advertised in UNDB; it is therefore a mandated publication channel for the largest, most competitive MK donor-funded IT/financial contracts.

source_name: USAID / foreign-assistance award data for North Macedonia (CATALYZE, private-sector growth activities)
why_relevant: USAID-funded MK/Western Balkans activities have produced fintech deliverables (e.g. the CATALYZE Engines of Growth partnership with Creative Business Solutions launching the LORES+ SME online-lending platform, expanding to North Macedonia). US federal award data identifies the prime implementers — competitors and potential partners in MK digital-finance work.

source_name: US Commercial Service — North Macedonia Country Commercial Guide, 'Selling to the Public Sector'
why_relevant: Concise official orientation to how MK public and donor-funded procurement actually works (PPB/ESPP registration requirements, IFI channels), useful for calibrating collection design and for identifying which channel a given contract will surface in.

source_name: State Audit Office of North Macedonia (Државен завод за ревизија) — audits of IFI-financed borrowing and projects
why_relevant: Audit reports on public-sector borrowing and donor-financed projects retrospectively disclose contract values, contractors and implementation failures that procurement notices omit — an 'audits' category source that reveals what actually happened after award.

source_name: EU4Digital Facility (regional IPA/Enlargement digital programme covering North Macedonia)
why_relevant: Regional EU-funded facility whose Phase III explicitly lists North Macedonia among beneficiary countries in Macro-Economy & Public Finance and ICT sectors; regional lots are a common route by which international consultancies enter MK digital-finance work without a MK-specific tender ever being issued.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com.mk — general job board (IT / banking listings)
why_relevant: Largest MK job board; MK banks (NLB Banka, Komercijalna, Sparkasse, Halkbank) and IT vendors post role descriptions that enumerate required platforms and stacks (core banking, card systems, MS SQL, Oracle, ESB), leaking incumbent vendor products inside private banks.

source_name: Bankarstvo.mk — banking-sector job-ad aggregator (огласи за вработување tag)
why_relevant: Specialist MK banking portal that republishes essentially every bank/financial-institution job ad (NLB, Komercijalna, Stopanska, Sparkasse, Silk Road, ProCredit, Eazy Finance, CaSys). Best single pointer for A6 hiring signals — turns a scattered board search into one sector-filtered feed, and its company tags snowball into an actor map.

source_name: Stopanska banka AD Skopje — careers / job ads (card system administrator)
why_relevant: The bank itself publishes ads such as 'Администратор на картичен систем' whose duty lists describe the card system, ATM network and central POS terminal management stack in use — direct evidence of the incumbent card/ATM platform inside an NBG-legacy bank.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Skopje — Кариера / employment page
why_relevant: NLB posts IT Security Engineer / system-engineer and card-operations roles; requirement lists name the security, database and card-processing products in production. Applications go to nlbkariera@nlb.mk, so ads are self-published and complete.

source_name: Komercijalna banka AD Skopje — careers section
why_relevant: Largest domestically-owned MK bank; its self-published vacancies in the careers section are the main indirect read on its core-banking, channel and card stack. Exact careers sub-path not confirmed in this pass — treat the root domain as the entry point.
